listing: static from source; the server contacts Slack at startup, so it cannot list tools with network off. Default = user OAuth token (xoxp), no optional SLACK_MCP_* flags.

tools.description: Get messages from the channel (or DM) by channel_id, the last row/column in the response is used as 'cursor' parameter for pagination if not empty
tools.name: conversations_history

reasons.P: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)
reasons.U: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)

tools.description: Get a thread of messages posted to a conversation by channelID and thread_ts, the last row/column in the response is used as 'cursor' parameter for pagination if not empty
tools.name: conversations_replies

reasons.P: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)
reasons.U: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)

tools.description: Search messages in a public channel, private channel, or direct message (DM, or IM) conversation using filters. All filters are optional, if not provided then search_query is required.
tools.name: conversations_search_messages

reasons.P: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)
reasons.U: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)

tools.description: Search for users by name, email, display name, or Slack user ID. If a Slack user ID is provided (e.g. U07VCEPP4N5), the user is looked up directly. Returns user details and DM channel ID if available.
tools.name: users_search

reasons.P: returns workspace directory details outsiders cannot see

tools.description: Get unread messages across all channels. With browser session tokens (xoxc/xoxd), uses a single API call for complete results. With OAuth user tokens (xoxp), scans a subset of channels per type (limited by max_channels) — results may be partial on large workspaces. Results are prioritized: DMs > group DMs > partner channels > internal channels.
tools.name: conversations_unreads

reasons.P: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)
reasons.U: returns channel, DM or thread messages: private to the workspace (P), written by other people (U)

tools.description: Mark a channel or DM as read. If no timestamp is provided, marks all messages as read.
tools.name: conversations_mark

reasons.none: changes the user's own state without text others read

tools.description: Leave a channel, group conversation, or DM. Cannot leave the #general channel.
tools.name: conversations_leave

reasons.none: changes the user's own state without text others read

tools.description: Join a public channel. Use channels_list or channels_me to find channel IDs.
tools.name: conversations_join

reasons.none: changes the user's own state without text others read

reasons.P: returns workspace directory details outsiders cannot see

tools.description: List channels you are a member of. Unlike channels_list which returns all workspace channels, this returns only channels you have joined. Useful on large workspaces where channels_list returns thousands of results.
tools.name: channels_me

reasons.P: returns workspace directory details outsiders cannot see

tools.description: List all user groups (subteams) in the Slack workspace. User groups are mention groups like @engineering or @design that notify all members. Use this to discover available groups, check group membership counts, or find a group's ID before joining/updating it. Returns CSV with columns: id, name, handle, description, user_count, is_external.
tools.name: usergroups_list

reasons.P: returns user groups and their descriptions, written by other members
reasons.U: returns user groups and their descriptions, written by other members

tools.description: Manage your own user group membership. Use action='list' to see which groups you belong to. Use action='join' with a usergroup_id to add yourself to a group (e.g., to receive @mentions). Use action='leave' with a usergroup_id to remove yourself. This is the easiest way to join/leave groups without needing to know the full member list.
tools.name: usergroups_me

reasons.none: changes the user's own state without text others read

tools.description: Create a new user group (mention group) in the Slack workspace. After creation, use usergroups_users_update to add members, or users can join themselves with usergroups_me. The handle becomes the @mention (e.g., handle='engineering' creates @engineering).
tools.name: usergroups_create

reasons.E: writes a group name, handle or description that every member of the workspace can read

tools.description: Update a user group's metadata: name, handle (@mention), description, or default channels. Does NOT change members - use usergroups_users_update for that. At least one field must be provided.
tools.name: usergroups_update

reasons.E: writes a group name, handle or description that every member of the workspace can read

tools.description: Replace all members of a user group with a new list. WARNING: This completely replaces the member list - any user not in the 'users' parameter will be removed. To add/remove just yourself, use usergroups_me instead. To add a single user without removing others, first get current members from usergroups_list with include_users=true, then call this with the combined list.
tools.name: usergroups_users_update

reasons.none: changes the user's own state without text others read

tools.description: Update a saved item: mark as completed, set a due date, or both. Use item_id and ts values from saved_list output. Replaces the deprecated stars.add/stars.remove APIs.
tools.name: saved_update

reasons.none: changes the user's own state without text others read

tools.description: Clear all completed saved items from the 'Save for Later' panel. This is a bulk operation that removes all items with state='completed'.
tools.name: saved_clear_completed

reasons.none: changes the user's own state without text others read
